evidence.snippet: Deangelo (with Dwight and Michael outside Michael's car): You know what, I have to go to the bathroom.

beats.summary: Michael announces the recipient of the 'Doobie Doobie Pothead Stoner of the Year Award' as Andy.

evidence.snippet: Michael (in conference room): Here… Okay! By his own omission, this person actually tried marijuana in college, so the Doobie Doobie Pothead Stoner of the Year Award goes to, Andy Bernard!

beats.summary: The office members sing a song about the minutes they've worked, celebrating Michael.

evidence.snippet: All: Nine million, nine hundred eighty six thousand minutes! That's how many minutes, that you've worked here.

beats.summary: Toby is called to accept the Extreme Repulsiveness Award and discusses the case of the Scranton Strangler.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Here he comes! Alright! You deserve it!
Toby: I really disagree with this. I think it's kind of hateful. Though I am a little happy right now to have a platform to talk about the outcome of a case I was recently a juror on.
